objective: Detect the start of a released hallucination span, then model whether risk continues or stops, while preserving the frozen 4-raw-BPE evaluation geometry.

current_run_actions: CPU human-only strict group OOF diagnostic
label-blind RAGognize replay planning and static selfcheck
hard_constraints.model_training_in_current_run: CPU-only human-fit diagnostic heads; no silver pretraining and no final candidate fit

silver_pretrain_primary.name: ragognize_train_no_hint_silver
silver_pretrain_primary.annotation: RAGognize released automatic spans; unmarked tokens are silver negatives, not human-verified negatives

silver_capacity_ablation.name: ragognize_train_all_silver
silver_capacity_ablation.rule: This superset replaces the no-hint cohort in an OOF-only ablation; never concatenate the two cohorts and never send this ablation to the one-shot calibration run.

data.cross_source_collision_rule: Before every fold, union groups sharing an exact NFC-and-whitespace-normalized question, retrieved-passage block, or response hash across sources; the v1 census found zero such intersections.

label_geometry.tokenizer_axis: Frozen local Llama-2 raw BPE offsets already stored by each conversion.
label_geometry.lexical_rule: A BPE is lexical iff its clipped response interval contains at least one Unicode alphanumeric character.
label_geometry.risk_rule: A lexical BPE is risky iff an alphanumeric character in its interval lies inside at least one valid released character span.
label_geometry.released_span_onset_target: For every valid released span, select its first intersecting lexical raw BPE. Duplicate starts collapse to one y_first=1 position for the start-head auxiliary loss; the original span count remains reported.
label_geometry.binary_state_target: z_i is the union risk mask on the lexical-BPE-only sequence. Binary segment starts are its 0->1 transitions. Overlapping or punctuation-separated released spans that have no clean lexical BPE between them become one realizable binary segment.
label_geometry.nonlexical_tokens: Context only. They receive no start, continuation, stop, or risk loss.
label_geometry.terminal_stop: Append one EOS stop event when the last lexical BPE is risky; EOS is not an evaluation token.

window_mapping.eligible: At least one lexical BPE in the raw-BPE window.
window_mapping.token_to_window_score: Maximum decoded risk probability over lexical BPEs in the window.
window_mapping.gold_onset_window: Contains at least one mapped released-span onset; this category takes priority over continuation.
window_mapping.gold_internal_continuation_window: Risk-positive and contains no mapped released-span onset.
window_mapping.gold_clean_window: Contains no released lexical risk BPE.
window_mapping.answer_score: Maximum score over all eligible 4-BPE windows in the answer.

required_reference_conditioned.name: generator_hidden
required_reference_conditioned.source: Teacher-forced final-layer hidden state aligned to the answer token; RAGTruth fit cache key hidden_last has 4096 dimensions.
required_reference_conditioned.projection: Frozen Rademacher 4096->32 projection, NumPy PCG64 seed 20260913, entries +/-1/sqrt(32).

required_reference_conditioned.name: lookback
required_reference_conditioned.source: Per-layer/per-head reference-vs-generated-prefix attention ratio; RAGTruth fit cache key lb has 1024 dimensions.
required_reference_conditioned.projection: Frozen Rademacher 1024->32 projection, NumPy PCG64 seed 20260914, entries +/-1/sqrt(32).

required_reference_conditioned.name: chosen_token_nll
required_reference_conditioned.source: Teacher-forced chosen-token negative log probability; RAGTruth fit cache key nll.
derived_causal_scalars: nll_i - nll_previous_lexical (0 at the first lexical token)
mean nll over current and previous three lexical tokens

input_signals.normalization: Mean and standard deviation learned from the human outer-training groups only, separately in every OOF fold; zero-variance columns map to zero.
input_signals.historical_trace_claim: All signals are teacher-forced replay features unless an actual native trace exists; do not describe replay as the original sampling trajectory.

optional_cortex_feature_ablation.prerequisite: Two token-aligned post-hoc inputs containing the same question and answer, one with retrieved references and one without; no such RAGognize cache exists now.
features: c_i = Delta h_i - sum_{j<i} attention_ref(i,j) * Delta h_j
optional_cortex_feature_ablation.projection: Apply separate frozen 32-dimensional Rademacher projections before concatenation.
optional_cortex_feature_ablation.scope: Fit-OOF-only ablation until selected and frozen; using these features inside the asymmetric onset/continuation model is not an original CORTEX baseline.

model.name: OSR-Linear-68
model.capacity: Two L2-regularized linear heads; no learned encoder, convolution, Transformer, or hidden MLP.

heads.continuation: p_cont(i)=sigmoid(w_cont^T x_i+b_cont); 1 means continue risk and 0 means stop

asymmetric_chain.reported_score: Use the soft risk probability from the recurrence for token/window/answer metrics; Viterbi spans are descriptive only.

loss.transition_nll: Gold-path negative log likelihood: use p_on at lexical positions whose previous gold union state is 0, and p_cont at positions whose previous gold state is 1, including the terminal EOS stop.
loss.released_onset_auxiliary: Balanced binary cross entropy on y_first over all lexical BPEs, sharing the onset head. This preserves supervision for released span starts that binary union geometry merges.
loss.balancing: Give each material group equal total mass, answers equal mass within a group, then balance positive and negative cells within each head using training-fold counts only.
loss.no_synthetic_labels: Every target is a deterministic transformation of a released span. Do not inject, rewrite, negate, or rule-generate answer text.

training_stages.fold_assignment: fold = uint64_be(SHA256(namespace + NUL + group_id)[0:8]) mod 5; namespace is ragtruth_fit_human for human OOF.
per_fold: Hold out every RAGTruth answer in one material group fold before normalization or fitting.
Fit normalization on the four human training folds only.
Pretrain the two heads for 15 fixed epochs on all no-hint RAGognize train groups after applying that fold's human normalization; batch by complete answers; learning rate 0.001.
Fine-tune for 25 fixed epochs on the four human RAGTruth folds; learning rate 0.0003.
Score only the held human groups to create OOF predictions. No early stopping or fold-specific hyperparameter choice.
training_stages.final_fit: After the protocol and OOF thresholds are frozen, repeat silver pretraining and human fine-tuning once using all RAGTruth fit groups; fit normalization on all human fit only.
training_stages.silver_group_rule: RAGognize groups never split across batches used as validation/diagnostic units. Silver labels never enter the held human fold. Any future cross-source exact collision is excluded from the corresponding fold.
training_stages.feature_generation_rule: Frozen, label-blind replay may be cached once, but learned projections, scaling, head weights, thresholds, and any score-level feature must obey the group split.

diagnostic_variants_not_eligible_for_cal: CORTEX feature ablation unless a new protocol version freezes it before calibration
oof_selection.threshold_candidates: Every distinct pooled human-fit OOF score plus 1.0+epsilon; predict positive when score >= threshold.
oof_selection.answer_threshold: Selected independently by the same tie-break on answer=max pooled human-fit OOF scores.

one_shot_calibration_development_validat.allowed_after_freeze: Open calibration labels once, compute the frozen metrics, and stop. No threshold optimization, checkpoint choice, feature change, or rerun based on calibration errors.

acceptance_gate.interpretation: These are historical repeatedly calibration-selected development references, not independent test claims.

one_shot_calibration_development_validat.failure_rule: Retain the incumbent and archive this v1 candidate. Any redesign becomes v2 and cannot turn the same calibration set into confirmatory evidence.
one_shot_calibration_development_validat.official_test: Remain sealed until a separate final-release protocol authorizes one evaluation.

method_identity.first_hallucination_tokens_original: Position-aware analysis of logit-derived scalar signals on RAGTruth; it reports stronger first-token detectability and explicitly leaves a deployable classifier for future work.
method_identity.cortex_original: Paired reference/no-reference final hidden-state delta, attention contextual residual, token MLP with weighted BCE, and symmetric label-persistence smoothing; answer score is token max.
new_in_this_design: A supervised released-span onset auxiliary target
Separate asymmetric start and continuation/stop heads
A transition recurrence that turns those heads into span risk
Silver automatic-span pretraining followed by human-span group-OOF fine-tuning
method_identity.naming_rule: Report the proposed model as OSR-Linear-68 (ours). Do not call it First-Hallucination-Tokens, CORTEX, Lookback, or an original baseline.
